subject: Onboarding launch cadence: console + API enablement
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@bryte.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bryte.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood onboarding — kickoff slot

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Bryte is excited to get our engineers into the console and start API work. We'd like to schedule an onboarding that covers (1) a console walkthrough for our product & security teams and (2) an API enablement session for our backend engineers. Preferably two shorter sessions rather than one long block.

Our primary constraints: PST mornings (9–11am) or EST afternoons (1–4pm). Can you propose availability next week? Also — we'll want a short agenda so we can invite the right folks.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Turner
Senior PM, Bryte.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@bryte.ai>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bryte.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — kickoff slot

Hi Alex — great to hear. Looping in Dev (SE) and Laura (Customer Success) so we can staff both sessions.

Proposal:
- Session A — Console walkthrough (30–40m): PST Tue 2026-11-17 09:30–10:10 OR Wed 2026-11-18 09:30–10:10
- Session B — API enablement (60m): PST Thu 2026-11-19 09:00–10:00 OR Fri 2026-11-20 10:00–11:00 (we can split to 45m if you prefer)

Attached is a draft agenda and a small set of example payloads we can use in the hands-on portion. If you want a single-day option we can compress but recommend separate days so engineering can digest the API bits.

Next steps: pick preferred slots and let us know which internal attendees will join each session.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | soojin@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_onboard_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: example_api_payloads.json (JSON)
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@bryte.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bryte.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — kickoff slot

Thanks — that looks good. Quick clarification from our side: for the API session we want a heavier hands-on portion focused on auth, rate limits, and best practices for batching/kv cache. Can Dev include a 15–20 minute live walkthrough of a sample integration (token handling + streaming)?

Preferred slots for us:
- Console walkthrough: Wed 2026-11-18 09:30 PST (Sara + 2 security engineers)
- API session: Thu 2026-11-19 09:00 PST (backend x3, infra x1)

If those solidify, we'll send calendar invites and shared Zoom link.

—Alex
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@bryte.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T10:11:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — kickoff slot

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 08:15 AM Alex Turner <alex.turner@bryte.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — that looks good. Quick clarification from our side: for the API session we want a heavier hands-on portion focused on auth, rate limits, and best practices for batching/kv cache. Can Dev include a 15–20 minute live walkthrough of a sample integration (token handling + streaming)?

Absolutely — I can do a 20-minute live demo showing a small integration (Bearer token refresh, request throttling limits, and a streaming example using our SDK). I'll prepare a short sandbox repo and run through the step-by-step.

One ask: can the backend folks open a test API key (or use a short-lived demo key) in advance so we can avoid setup time? If you prefer we can also do a shared sandbox environment.

I'll be on the Thu 11/19 API session.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@bryte.ai>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@bryte.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — kickoff slot

Perfect — I've penciled in the sessions and created a pair of calendar events (Zoom link below). Invite details:

- Console walkthrough — Wed 2026-11-18 09:30–10:10 PST (Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210)
- API enablement — Thu 2026-11-19 09:00–10:00 PST (Zoom: same link)

Attachments: redwood_onboard_agenda_v2.pdf (final) — includes a 10-minute security section and the API sandbox prep checklist.

Prep checklist for API session (short):
- Create one demo API key for the backend team OR request a short-lived sandbox key from support@redwood.ai
- Confirm who will share screen for the infra questions (Alex/Sara)
- Optional: paste 1–2 example input prompts in the shared doc so we can test batching behavior

HubSpot: HS: 0045123 (I've added the sessions and attendees to the contact record).

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
